question: List 5 customers
sql: SELECT c."CustomerID", c."CompanyName" FROM Customers AS c GROUP BY c."CustomerID", c."CompanyName" ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders AS o WHERE o."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID") DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show 10 orders
sql: SELECT o."OrderID", o."CustomerID", o."EmployeeID", o."OrderDate", o."ShippedDate" FROM Orders AS o ORDER BY o."OrderDate" DESC LIMIT 10

question: Count total orders
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "OrderID") AS "OrderCount" FROM Orders AS o

question: Top 5 customers by number of orders
sql: SELECT c."CustomerID", c."CompanyName", COUNT(DISTINCT o."OrderID") AS "OrderCount" FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON c."CustomerID" = o."CustomerID" GROUP BY c."CustomerID", c."CompanyName" ORDER BY "OrderCount" DESC LIMIT 5

question: Orders by ship country
sql: SELECT "ShipCountry", COUNT(DISTINCT "OrderID") AS "OrderCount" FROM Orders AS o GROUP BY "ShipCountry" ORDER BY "OrderCount" DESC LIMIT 200

question: Top 10 products by quantity sold
sql: SELECT "ProductName", SUM("od"."Quantity") AS "TotalQuantitySold" FROM Products AS p JOIN "Order Details" AS od ON p."ProductID" = od."ProductID" GROUP BY "ProductName" ORDER BY "TotalQuantitySold" DESC LIMIT 10

question: Revenue by country
sql: SELECT "ShipCountry" AS "Country", SUM(od."UnitPrice" * od."Quantity" * (1 - od."Discount")) AS "Revenue" FROM Orders AS o JOIN "Order Details" AS od ON o."OrderID" = od."OrderID" GROUP BY "ShipCountry" ORDER BY "Revenue" DESC LIMIT 200

question: Revenue by product category
sql: SELECT cat."CategoryName" AS "Category", SUM(od."UnitPrice" * od."Quantity" * (1 - od."Discount")) AS "Revenue" FROM Products AS p JOIN "Order Details" AS od ON p."ProductID" = od."ProductID" JOIN Categories AS cat ON p."CategoryID" = cat."CategoryID" GROUP BY cat."CategoryName" ORDER BY "Revenue" DESC LIMIT 200

question: Monthly order count in 1997
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o."OrderDate") AS "Month", COUNT(*) AS "OrderCount" FROM Orders AS o WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o."OrderDate") = '1997' GROUP BY "Month" ORDER BY "Month" ASC LIMIT 200

question: Top 5 products by revenue

question: Top 5 customers by revenue

question: Average order value by country
sql: SELECT c."Country" AS "Country", SUM(od."UnitPrice" * od."Quantity" * (1 - od."Discount")) / COUNT(DISTINCT o."OrderID") AS "AverageOrderValue" FROM Orders AS o JOIN "Order Details" AS od ON o."OrderID" = od."OrderID" JOIN Customers AS c ON o."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID" GROUP BY c."Country" ORDER BY "AverageOrderValue" DESC LIMIT 200

question: Revenue trend by month

question: Number of orders handled by each employee
